checked.found: Sources agree construction of the minar began about 1199 under Aibak (1192 is the adjoining mosque).
Caliph al-Mustansir's investiture of Iltutmish, with robe of honour, is dated 1229 (consistent with spine source; not contradicted).
Alauddin killed Jalaluddin and took the throne in 1296 after the Devagiri raid.
Siege of Chittorgarh 1303.
Firozabad founded 1354 with the Ashokan pillar atop the palace.
Sack of Delhi December 1398.
Bahlul Lodi took the Delhi throne in 1451.
Sikandar Lodi founded/established Agra in 1504.
Battle of Kannauj 17 May 1540.
Most sources: built 1565-1572, commissioned by Bega Begum; an older manuscript tradition says 1569. 1565 is the standard start.
Battle of Haldighati 18 June 1576; Man Singh led the Mughals.
Jahangir acceded October 1605 at Agra.
Married Mehr-un-Nissa (Nur Jahan), widow of Sher Afgan, in 1611.
Commissioned 1628, inaugurated 22 March 1635 (Nowruz); 'twice the cost of the Taj' is a widely repeated claim, and the description hedges it with 'said to'.
Red Fort construction began 1638 (completed 1648); some sources say 1639.
Begun 1650, completed 1656; about 5,000 workers.
Aurangzeb imprisoned Shah Jahan at Agra and was crowned in 1658.
Badshahi Mosque built 1671-1673.
Aurangzeb died 3 March 1707 at Ahmednagar in the Deccan.

Marathas retook Delhi in early 1771 and the agreement was made in 1771, but several sources date Shah Alam II's actual return to Delhi to 1772 (others 1771-72, arriving late December 1771). Sources split.
Succeeded Akbar II on 28 September 1837.

Captured September 1857 and his reign is usually ended then, but the trial (Jan-Mar 1858) and exile to Rangoon (Oct 1858) are 1858, and the description includes both, so the year is contested between 1857 and 1858.
